ns2:course.label: Ethical & Professional Issues
ns2:course.description: Ethics for the computing profession. Ethical decision-making; licensing; intellectual property, freedom of information, and privacy. Credit is not given for both CS 210 and ECE 316. Junior standing required. Prerequisite: CS 225.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both CS 210 and ECE 316. Junior standing required. Prerequisite: CS 225.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Computer Science department.
